title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3610: 98% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 26 Mar 2025
Progress Toward Outcome: As of 30 September 2022, progress is 86%. The overall progress slowed down due to COVID-19 during 2020/21, followed by the current economic crisis.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jun 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/47273/47273-003-47273-004-47273-005-47273-006-apfs-en_5.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Mar 2022: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/47273/47273-006-iee-en.pdf
Some results are in the Safeguards Due Diligence Reports | Apr 2022: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/47273/47273-006-sddr-en_0.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Nov 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/47273/47273-003-47273-004-47273-005-47273-006-smr-en_10.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: 1. Contracts awarded to improve 2,710 km of rural roads and 2,531 km completed. Performance Based Maintenance is in progress on the road section rehabilitation is completed. 378 km national road awarded and 96 km completed. Procurement is ongoing for 32 km length national roads.
2. Altogether 140 workshops, training and seminars were conducted. Out of this 65 are related to the capacity development of road agencies (RDA, PRDA and Local Authorities). Approximately 500 staff members benefited. Rural road design standard, construction specification, and maintenance manual endorsed by RDA
